findings.location: docs/feature/ui-bare-pages/architecture.md:382 (Constraints, DEVIATION from P4's wording); brief.md P4 and Decisions

findings.location: docs/product/architecture/ADR-002.md Decision and Consequences; architecture.md:336 and :402 (show_keyboard_help)
findings.obligation: One URL that answers two different bodies by a request header must name its cache contract, so a cache or the back-forward cache cannot hand the fragment to a navigation or the framed document to the overlay fetch.
findings.observation: ADR-002 and the design say nothing about Vary or Cache-Control for GET /keyboard-help. Shipped dynamic responses carry no Vary (grep of crates/foundry-app/src finds none; the Cache-Control middleware at lib.rs:311 only stamps /static). A cache keyed on URL alone can serve the fragment to a navigation (the unstyled page returns) or the document to keyboard.js:323 (nested html in the host). The Quint model has only the four destinations and cannot see this.
findings.remediation: Add to ADR-002 and the show_keyboard_help target: both arms send Vary: Sec-Fetch-Dest (or Cache-Control: no-store on both), and add one oracle read that the header is present on both arms.
